verses.en: Furthermore Elihu answered and said,
verses.pt: Prosseguiu Eliú, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Moreover Elihu answered,
verses.en_bbe: And Elihu made answer and said,

verses.en: Hear my words, O ye wise men; and give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.
verses.pt: Ouvi, vós, sábios, as minhas palavras; e vós, entendidos, inclinai os ouvidos para mim.
verses.en_web: “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear, you wise, to my words; and you who have knowledge, give attention to me;

verses.en: For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat.
verses.pt: Pois o ouvido prova as palavras, como o paladar experimenta a comida.
verses.en_web: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.
verses.en_bbe: For words are tested by the ear, as food is tasted by the mouth.

verses.en: Let us choose to us judgment: let us know among ourselves what is good.
verses.pt: O que é direito escolhamos para nós; e conheçamos entre nós o que é bom.
verses.en_web: Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.
verses.en_bbe: Let us make the decision for ourselves as to what is right; let us have the knowledge among ourselves of what is good.

verses.en: For Job hath said, I am righteous: and God hath taken away my judgment.
verses.pt: Pois Jó disse: Sou justo, e Deus tirou-me o direito.
verses.en_web: For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right:
verses.en_bbe: For Job has said, I am upright, and it is God who has taken away my right;

verses.en: Should I lie against my right? my wound is incurable without transgression.
verses.pt: Apesar do meu direito, sou considerado mentiroso; a minha ferida é incurável, embora eu esteja sem transgressão.
verses.en_web: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’
verses.en_bbe: Though I am right, still I am in pain; my wound may not be made well, though I have done no wrong.

verses.en: What man is like Job, who drinketh up scorning like water?
verses.pt: Que homem há como Jó, que bebe o escárnio como água,
verses.en_web: What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,
verses.en_bbe: What man is like Job, a man who freely makes sport of God,

verses.en: Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, and walketh with wicked men.
verses.pt: que anda na companhia dos malfeitores, e caminha com homens ímpios?
verses.en_web: Who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?
verses.en_bbe: And goes in the company of evil-doers, walking in the way of sinners?

verses.en: For he hath said, It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.
verses.pt: Porque disse: De nada aproveita ao homem o comprazer-se em Deus.
verses.en_web: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’
verses.en_bbe: For he has said, It is no profit to a man to take delight in God.

verses.en: Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness; and from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
verses.pt: Pelo que ouvi-me, vós homens de entendimento: longe de Deus o praticar a maldade, e do Todo-Poderoso o cometer a iniqüidade!
verses.en_web: “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
verses.en_bbe: Now then, you wise, take note; you men of knowledge, give ear to me. Let it be far from God to do evil, and from the Ruler of all to do wrong.

verses.en: For the work of a man shall he render unto him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.
verses.pt: Pois, segundo a obra do homem, ele lhe retribui, e faz a cada um segundo o seu caminho.
verses.en_web: For the work of a man he will render to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.
verses.en_bbe: For he gives to every man the reward of his work, and sees that he gets the fruit of his ways.

verses.en: Yea, surely God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.
verses.pt: Na verdade, Deus não procederá impiamente, nem o Todo-Poderoso perverterá o juízo.
verses.en_web: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, God does not do evil, and the Ruler of all is not a false judge.

verses.en: Who hath given him a charge over the earth? or who hath disposed the whole world?
verses.pt: Quem lhe entregou o governo da terra? E quem lhe deu autoridade sobre o mundo todo?
verses.en_web: Who put him in charge of the earth? or who has appointed him over the whole world?
verses.en_bbe: Who put the earth into his care, or made him responsible for the world?

verses.en: If he set his heart upon man, if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;
verses.pt: Se ele retirasse para si o seu espírito, e recolhesse para si o seu fôlego,
verses.en_web: If he set his heart on himself, If he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,
verses.en_bbe: If he made his spirit come back to him, taking his breath into himself again,

verses.en: All flesh shall perish together, and man shall turn again unto dust.
verses.pt: toda a carne juntamente expiraria, e o homem voltaria para o pó.
verses.en_web: all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.
verses.en_bbe: All flesh would come to an end together, and man would go back to the dust.

verses.en: If now thou hast understanding, hear this: hearken to the voice of my words.
verses.pt: Se, pois, há em ti entendimento, ouve isto, inclina os ouvidos às palavras que profiro.
verses.en_web: “If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.
verses.en_bbe: If you are wise, take note of this; give ear to the voice of my words.

verses.en: Shall even he that hateth right govern? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just?
verses.pt: Acaso quem odeia o direito governará? Quererás tu condenar aquele que é justo e poderoso?
verses.en_web: Shall even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty?—
verses.en_bbe: How may a hater of right be a ruler? and will you say that the upright Ruler of all is evil?

verses.en: Is it fit to say to a king, Thou art wicked? and to princes, Ye are ungodly?
verses.pt: aquele que diz a um rei: ó vil? e aos príncipes: ó ímpios?
verses.en_web: Who says to a king, ‘Vile!’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked!’?
verses.en_bbe: He who says to a king, You are an evil-doer; and to rulers, You are sinners;

verses.en: How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes, nor regardeth the rich more than the poor? for they all are the work of his hands.
verses.pt: que não faz acepção das pessoas de príncipes, nem estima o rico mais do que o pobre; porque todos são obra de suas mãos?
verses.en_web: Who doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respects the rich more than the poor; for they all are the work of his hands.
verses.en_bbe: Who has no respect for rulers, and who gives no more attention to those who have wealth than to the poor, for they are all the work of his hands.

verses.en: In a moment shall they die, and the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away: and the mighty shall be taken away without hand.
verses.pt: Eles num momento morrem; e à meia-noite os povos são perturbados, e passam, e os poderosos são levados não por mão humana.
verses.en_web: In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.
verses.en_bbe: Suddenly they come to an end, even in the middle of the night: the blow comes on the men of wealth, and they are gone, and the strong are taken away without the hand of man.

verses.en: For his eyes are upon the ways of man, and he seeth all his goings.
verses.pt: Porque os seus olhos estão sobre os caminhos de cada um, e ele vê todos os seus passos.
verses.en_web: “For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.
verses.en_bbe: For his eyes are on the ways of a man, and he sees all his steps.

verses.en: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
verses.pt: Não há escuridão nem densas trevas, onde se escondam os obradores da iniqüidade.
verses.en_web: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
verses.en_bbe: There is no dark place, and no thick cloud, in which the workers of evil may take cover.

verses.en: For he will not lay upon man more than right; that he should enter into judgment with God.
verses.pt: Porque Deus não precisa observar por muito tempo o homem para que este compareça perante ele em juízo.
verses.en_web: For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.
verses.en_bbe: For he does not give man a fixed time to come before him to be judged.

verses.en: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number, and set others in their stead.
verses.pt: Ele quebranta os fortes, sem inquiriçao, e põe outros em lugar deles.
verses.en_web: He breaks in pieces mighty men in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.
verses.en_bbe: He sends the strong to destruction without searching out their cause, and puts others in their place.

verses.en: Therefore he knoweth their works, and he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
verses.pt: Pois conhecendo ele as suas obras, de noite os transtorna, e ficam esmagados.
verses.en_web: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
verses.en_bbe: For he has knowledge of their works, overturning them in the night, so that they are crushed.

verses.en: He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others;
verses.pt: Ele os fere como ímpios, à vista dos circunstantes;
verses.en_web: He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others;
verses.en_bbe: The evil-doers are broken by his wrath, he puts his hand on them with force before the eyes of all onlookers.

verses.en: Because they turned back from him, and would not consider any of his ways:
verses.pt: porquanto se desviaram dele, e não quiseram compreender nenhum de seus caminhos,
verses.en_web: because they turned away from following him, and wouldn’t pay attention to any of his ways,
verses.en_bbe: Because they did not go after him, and took no note of his ways,

verses.en: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, and he heareth the cry of the afflicted.
verses.pt: de sorte que o clamor do pobre subisse até ele, e que ouvisse o clamor dos aflitos.
verses.en_web: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.
verses.en_bbe: So that the cry of the poor might come up to him, and the prayer of those in need come to his ears.

verses.en: When he giveth quietness, who then can make trouble? and when he hideth his face, who then can behold him? whether it be done against a nation, or against a man only:
verses.pt: Se ele dá tranqüilidade, quem então o condenará? Se ele encobrir o rosto, quem então o poderá contemplar, quer seja uma nação, quer seja um homem só?
verses.en_web: When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? Alike whether to a nation, or to a man,

verses.en: That the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared.
verses.pt: para que o ímpio não reine, e não haja quem iluda o povo.
verses.en_web: that the godless man may not reign, that there be no one to ensnare the people.

verses.en: Surely it is meet to be said unto God, I have borne chastisement, I will not offend any more:
verses.pt: Pois, quem jamais disse a Deus: Sofri, ainda que não pequei;
verses.en_web: “For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.

verses.en: That which I see not teach thou me: if I have done iniquity, I will do no more.
verses.pt: o que não vejo, ensina-me tu; se fiz alguma maldade, nunca mais a hei de fazer?
verses.en_web: Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?

verses.en: Should it be according to thy mind? he will recompense it, whether thou refuse, or whether thou choose; and not I: therefore speak what thou knowest.
verses.pt: Será a sua recompensa como queres, para que a recuses? Pois tu tens que fazer a escolha, e não eu; portanto fala o que sabes.
verses.en_web: Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.

verses.en: Let men of understanding tell me, and let a wise man hearken unto me.
verses.pt: Os homens de entendimento dir-me-ão, e o varão sábio, que me ouvir:
verses.en_web: Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:
verses.en_bbe: Men of knowledge, and all wise men, hearing me, will say,

verses.en: Job hath spoken without knowledge, and his words were without wisdom.
verses.pt: Jó fala sem conhecimento, e às suas palavras falta sabedoria.
verses.en_web: ‘Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.’
verses.en_bbe: Job's words do not come from knowledge; they are not the fruit of wisdom.

verses.en: My desire is that Job may be tried unto the end because of his answers for wicked men.
verses.pt: Oxalá que Jó fosse provado até o fim; porque responde como os iníquos.
verses.en_web: I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.
verses.en_bbe: May Job be tested to the end, because his answers have been like those of evil men.

verses.en: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, he clappeth his hands among us, and multiplieth his words against God.
verses.pt: Porque ao seu pecado acrescenta a rebelião; entre nós bate as palmas, e multiplica contra Deus as suas palavras.
verses.en_web: For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.”
verses.en_bbe: For in addition to his sin, he is uncontrolled in heart; before our eyes he makes sport of God, increasing his words against him.
